hotspots.title: Trump Waiver of Russia Sanctions Sparks Outrage
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's decision to waive newly enacted Russia sanctions and broker a massive Russian diesel deal for US farmers has triggered sharp international and domestic condemnation. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy denounced the move as directly aiding Moscow's war effort, while US lawmakers framed the waiver as a surrender to Vladimir Putin.
hotspots.affect: The abrupt policy shift on Russian sanctions created immediate international outrage, acute bipartisan anger, and widespread accusations of strategic betrayal.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Fuels Midterm Fever
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump headlined high-stakes midterm campaign rallies in key conservative strongholds like Kentucky, issuing aggressive attacks on Democrats and boasting of his executive power. The events sparked both fervent base enthusiasm and counter-mobilizations from opposition networks organizing nationwide 'No Kings' protests.
hotspots.affect: Escalating midterm campaign tensions drive intense polarization between triumphant rally rhetoric and fierce counter-demonstration anger.

hotspots.title: White House Staff Chaos and High-Profile Resignations
hotspots.blurb: High-profile personnel turmoil continues to shadow the White House following Press Secretary Katie Zacharia's departure after just five days in office. The rapid turnover, coupled with lingering ethics questions surrounding figures like Kimberly Guilfoyle and broader scrutiny of female cabinet departures, has fueled media criticism of administration instability.
hotspots.affect: Rapid administrative turnover and ethical controversies fuel intense media scrutiny and government instability narratives ahead of the midterms.

hotspots.title: Sylvi Listhaug and Progress Party Immigration Stance
hotspots.blurb: Progress Party (FrP) leader Sylvi Listhaug delivered hardline speeches targeting Norway's immigration policy at the party's national convention, arguing strict controls protect immigrants from clan culture while attacking opponents over rising fuel taxes. Her aggressive rhetoric highlights FrP's core strategy of mobilizing populist frustration around culture and cost of living.
hotspots.affect: Listhaug's provocative framing of immigration's 'shadow sides' and tax grievances drives intense ideological friction in Norwegian politics.
